punchline: Anxiety, loneliness, boredom, anger: the Intuitive Eating authors say food won't fix any of them.
thirty_sec: In Intuitive Eating, Evelyn Tribole and Elyse Resch devote one principle to feelings. Their point is plain: food only offers temporary relief from anxiety, loneliness, boredom or anger, and restriction can itself trigger loss of control. The title asks for kindness, not discipline. The research is thin, so if eating feels out of control, bring in a clinician.
